profile.heading: Edit profile
profile.intro: Change your profile details here (GDPR Art. 16). Your username is your platform identity and cannot be changed.
profile.discordMinorNote: The Discord tag is disabled for minors — other users cannot see it for youth-protection reasons, no matter what is entered here.
profile.languageHint: Sets the language of the entire interface — on any device, as soon as you are signed in.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist (anymore). The link may be outdated — or the page has been moved.

landing.heroTagline: The platform for Beyblade X tournaments in the DACH region.
landing.heroBody: Find events and clubs near you, manage your collection and your decks — and battle other Bladers.
landing.dachBody: BeybladeX.de connects Bladers from Germany, Austria and Switzerland: from local club meetups to big tournaments — with a shared calendar, map and rankings.
landing.ctaBody: Create your free profile and become part of the DACH Beyblade community.

events.title: Events & Tournaments
events.description: Find events in the DACH region and sign up — with check-in and live scoring right on the platform.

clubs.title: Clubs & Community
clubs.description: Find Beyblade clubs near you, join them and stay connected with your fellow Bladers via the club map and chat.

decks.title: Deck Builder
decks.description: Build your tournament decks and validate them directly against your format's deck rules.

collection.title: Collection Manager
collection.description: Track your Beyblades, parts and builds — your inventory, always at hand.

leaderboard.title: Rankings & Meta
leaderboard.description: ELO rankings, statistics and a look at which parts are winning in the meta.

rules.title: Rulebook
rules.description: The official rulebook with checklists — from stadium setup to the WBO deck regulations.
